$comment: This repository's own profile, so the toolkit is held to its own gate while being developed.
Tracked, unlike the others: it names only a public repo and public commands, and it doubles as
the one worked example in the repository, and the only profile here that actually runs.

checks.cmd: for f in scripts/*.sh hooks/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done

checks.when: always -- the gate is the one component that must fail closed, so its tests gate every turn
macOS ships bash 3.2; these pass on Linux and fail there

checks.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");for(const f of fs.readdirSync("templates"))if(f.endsWith(".json"))JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("templates/"+f,"utf8"));for(const f of fs.readdirSync("profiles"))if(f.endsWith(".json"))JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("profiles/"+f,"utf8"))'

checks.when: Claude Code does not read AGENTS.md, so if the symlink becomes a regular file the always-loaded layer silently drifts

checks.cmd: ! git ls-files -s scripts/*.sh hooks/*.sh | awk '$1!="100755"{print;f=1} END{exit !f}'
checks.when: every suite invokes through `bash <file>`, so a lost +x bit passes all of them and breaks `scripts/gate.sh arm`
da-review-all must keep creating its one-page Canvas review artifact

checks.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const steps=[...fs.readFileSync("scripts/check.sh","utf8").matchAll(/^[ \\t]*step .*?(\.\/scripts\/[a-z-]+\.sh)/gm)].map(m=>m[1]);const gated=require("./profiles/dotagents.json").checks.filter(c=>c.gate).map(c=>c.cmd).join(" ");const missing=steps.filter(s=>!gated.includes(s));if(missing.length){console.error("not gated by profiles/dotagents.json: "+missing.join(" "));process.exit(1)}console.log("all "+steps.length+" suites check.sh runs are gated")'
checks.when: a suite added to check.sh and not to this profile is a suite the gate stops running. Counting steps would not work -- the granularities differ (shell-syntax and no-bash4 are one check.sh step; templates-valid is not a check.sh step at all), so the invariant is coverage of the scripts check.sh invokes, not equal counts. The shell-function steps (syntax, CLAUDE.md symlink, exec bits) have their own checks above; the tree-clean step is about the suites not dirtying the repo and is meaningless inside the gate.
